messages:
rachel-support: Hey @leo-oncall — receiving a priority escalation from AcmeCorp. Their Hosted API calls are returning 502s and occasional 504s for the last ~10m during bulk embedding jobs. Customer saw errors spike right after our rolling config push. Trace IDs: ae3f1c, b7d2a9, c0ffee. sample curl: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`

leo-oncall: Ack. Looking now. Do we have any deploy events around 1811112000? @deploy-bot? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy event: config/redwood-edge:2026-03-17T10:06Z rolling -> 25% of edge nodes. CI job id: ci-8942. No errors flagged during CI.

jun-eng-sre: I see a bump in upstream 5xx from the edge-to-hosted pool starting ~1811111950. Envoy logs show: `upstream reset` and `503 no healthy upstream`. Pushing logs for a few traces into S3: s3://redwood-ops/edge/1811112223/debug.log

maya-product: Customer reports latency rising before the 502s, some requests took ~8-12s then failed. They were sending large batched embeddings (batch_size=256-ish).

rachel-support: Customer is in EU region, using hosted inference. They need mitigation while we triage — can we throttle or route their traffic to a different pool?

leo-oncall: Temporary mitigation: enabling fallback routing to dedicated-pool-2 for their tenant. Adding a header-based route for tenant-id: acme-1234. Executing now.

infra-bot: Route update: added route match header tenant=acme-1234 -> dedicated-pool-2. Propagated to edge region eu-west-1 in ~18s.

jun-eng-sre: Can we repro locally? Steps I used: 1) generate 250 concurrent curl requests with payload size ~120KB 2) observe h2 conn pool exhaustion on edge by running `wrk -t8 -c250 -d30s --script emb.lua` 3) tail envoy logs. I pushed a small repro playbook at https://internal/playbooks/edge-repro-502.md

rachel-support: Customer confirmed retries to a routed pool reduced 502 rate by ~80% in first 3m. They want a postmortem and root cause.

leo-oncall: Next steps: 1) keep fallback in place; 2) collect full envoy debug logs for the 3 trace ids; 3) check node-level TCP/timewait and h2 concurrent streams config after deploy; 4) rollback config if we find regression. Jun, can you grab pprof from the affected edge pods?

jun-eng-sre: On it. Also seeing auth cache spikes in metrics (auth-cache-hit drops to 12%). Could be auth backend thrash causing many upstream failures. Pulling auth-proxy logs now.

maya-product: Flagging with product: large batch embeddings may need advice + recommend batching guidance page for customers.

rachel-support: I'll keep customer updated and ask them to continue on routed pool. Logging timeline and will escalate to SE if they request SLA credit. :+1:

leo-oncall: If auth cache is root cause, we should consider adding a short-lived local auth cache fallback in the edge to reduce chattiness. Will open a ticket.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-145-edge-502s-acme. Pager duty: none. Severity: P2.

rachel-support: Thanks all — keeping thread open until we have root cause and postmortem.

jun-eng-sre: Collected pprof + logs -> uploaded to ops-bucket: s3://redwood-ops/edge/1811112223/pprof.tar.gz. Preliminary note: auth backend latency went from 30ms median to 800ms p95 around the window, correlates tightly with 502 spike.

leo-oncall: Sounds like cascading auth latency -> connection queueing -> upstream resets. Will coordinate a rollback of the config push if we confirm config change widened connection windows.

rachel-support: Customer says fallback routing is stable. Closing immediate escalation, will report back with RCA draft later today.
